metadataRaw.title: FULL BODY Stretch in Seconds #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a full body stretching exercise that can give quick pain and tightness relief from head to toes!

This exercise is very easy to do, requires no equipment, and can be done AT HOME. Also, it can be done daily to improve mobility (and flexibility) in the neck, back, and legs.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
